lines.trans: As it is, you are going to the exhibition.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: я, пожалуй, пойду = I think I'll be going

examples.trans: All right, I think I'll be going.

examples.text: Ладно, я, пожалуй, пойду. Пока, Нина!
examples.trans: All right, I think I'll go. Bye, Nina!

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'ставка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'exhibition' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: A representative of the exhibition from Milan called.

examples.text: Почему, Вик, на выставку не улетели?
examples.trans: Why didn't you fly out to the exhibition?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

улететь.gloss: to fly away, to depart by plane

meanings.en: to fly away, to fly out, to depart by air

examples.trans: What do you mean you didn't fly out?
Our plane has already flown out.

examples.text: Да, Аллочка? Как ты не улетела? Почему?
examples.trans: Yes, Allochka? What do you mean you didn't fly out? Why?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cancel', paired with 'отменять'.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то

examples.text: Бред какой-то. Но, с другой стороны, чем я рискую?
examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

meanings.note: Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (stem 'приниматель'). Agent/instrument noun formed with the productive Slavic suffix '-тель' ('-er'). Common substantive noun meaning 'entrepreneur' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Вам же звонил там какой-то предприниматель.
Это слово «предприниматель» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'entrepreneur' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
С этого момента вся правда отменяется!
examples.trans: From this moment on, all truth is canceled!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Паша, слушай. Это были не местные, а московские.
examples.trans: Pasha, listen. They weren't local police, they were from Moscow.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'number; phone number; hotel room' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Don't laugh. Read me the number.

набирать.gloss: to gain, gather, recruit; to dial

meanings.en: to dial (a phone number); to recruit

examples.trans: The firm is recruiting new employees.

examples.text: Он теперь набирает популярность. И Осипенко может проиграть выборы.
examples.trans: He is now gaining popularity. And Osipenko might lose the election.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: by plane or through the air

examples.text: Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: Everyone saw you fly out the window.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Или счёт в банке. Потому что они все обманщики.
examples.trans: Or a bank account. Because they are all cheats.
